## Skillerr 0.1.8 — Hotfix

**Fix**
- **Sign in with Google (and Apple) works on sites like X.** Their sign-in now opens in a small pop-up window, as in
  other browsers, instead of a new tab, which left Google's sign-in stuck on accounts.google.com/gsi/transform.
  Links that open in a new tab still open as tabs.

Installed copies on Windows, Linux AppImage, and signed Mac builds update themselves.
